map.max-age 和 s-maxage 有什么区别？: What is the difference between max-age and s-maxage?
map.max-age 对浏览器生效；s-maxage 只对共享缓存（CDN、代理）生效: max-age applies to the browser; s-maxage applies only to shared caches (CDNs, proxies) and takes precedence over max-age. A typical setup is max-age=0, s-maxage=600 for HTML: the browser revalidates every time and the CDN caches for 10 minutes, so updates still reach users promptly while origin load drops noticeably.
map.它告诉浏览器在 max-age 期间连条件请求都不要发（刷新页面也不必校验）。只: It tells the browser not even to send a conditional request during the max-age window (not even a page refresh triggers revalidation). Use it only for content-hashed, never-changing filenames — if the filename stays the same while the content changes, users are stuck on the stale copy until it expires, which is harder to recover from than simply omitting immutable.
